purpose: New photographic-style interior texture source images for lunar habitat application. Existing twelve source materials preserved.
notes: AI-generated photographic-style material sources, not measured material scans. PBR conversion and runtime checks are managed separately. Four successful final image outputs. Floor had two failed network attempts before successful generation with a shorter prompt.

materials.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: square seamless physically based material base-color source texture for a lunar habitat interior wall, one material covering the entire image.
Primary request: ultra-realistic orthographic macro material photograph of a light cool gray-white microperforated acoustic wall panel. Tiny evenly spaced round microholes in a very fine regular square lattice, with delicate matte powder-coated surface micrograin between holes. Clean and contemporary aerospace habitation interior finish.
Composition/framing: camera exactly perpendicular to the flat surface, no perspective, square image, all-over material, no panel edge. Fine homogeneous microhole scale suitable for believable wall cladding, not large dots. Every region equally sharply focused.
Lighting/mood: fully diffuse neutral cross-polarized studio illumination, de-lit albedo character, even brightness throughout, no directional highlights or baked shadows.
Color palette: very light neutral-cool gray body, gently darker gray tiny recessed microholes; subtle realistic natural surface variation.
Constraints: generate a single square material only; tileable edges, seamless across all four sides, small consistent pattern; material flat in the image plane; dry matte surface. No words, labels, watermark, logo, border, diagram, collage, split image, sphere, room, furniture, objects, heavy dirt, scratches, seams, dramatic light, vignette, depth of field or oblique angle.

visualInspection.notes: Visually inspected generated image: square, full-frame light-gray microperforated acoustic panel; consistent fine hole lattice and matte micrograin, no objects, text, edge or collage. Overall even lighting. Tiny hole interiors include shallow relief cues; pixel-exact periodicity has not been measured.
